title: Dark mode for the widget
body: My site goes dark at night and the feedback dialog glows like a hospital corridor. Please make it follow the theme.

comments.body: Planned for the next release. It already follows prefers-color-scheme; we are adding a switch for sites with their own theme toggle.

title: Ping me on Slack when a new argh arrives
body: I forget to open the admin page for weeks. A Slack message would save me from my own memory.

comments.body: Started. A single webhook URL in config.php, nothing else to install.

title: Export all entries to CSV
body: For the quarterly report I paste everything into a spreadsheet by hand. A CSV button would make my accountant happy.

title: Sync accepted ideas with GitHub issues
body: When an idea is planned, open an issue in my repo and close it when the idea is marked done.

title: The tab overlaps my chat bubble on mobile
body: Bottom right on my phone there is a chat bubble and your tab sits on top of it. I can tap neither.

comments.body: Fixed. Use data-offset to move the tab up or down, or data-position="left" to switch sides. Sorry about the pile-up.

title: Does it work with a strict Content Security Policy?
body: We send script-src 'self' on every page. Which hosts does the widget need?

comments.body: Yes. Allow your own origin for the scripts and challenges.cloudflare.com for Turnstile (script-src, frame-src and connect-src). The docs have a copy-paste policy.

title: Install guide for Hugo and other static site generators
body: I build my site with Hugo. Where exactly do I put the script tag so it survives a rebuild?

title: Vote button needs two taps on iPhone
body: Safari on iOS. The first tap seems to just focus the button, the second one votes.

comments.body: Reproduced on an iPhone SE. A fix is on its way, we are removing the hover state that causes it.

title: Let visitors attach a screenshot
body: A picture is worth a thousand words, especially for layout bugs.

comments.body: We keep ArghBox text-only on purpose: screenshots are the easiest way to collect personal data by accident. Instead every bug report carries the page path, browser and screen size.

title: A weekly email digest of new arghs
body: Not everything needs to ping me. One summary on Monday morning would be perfect.

title: Polish translation of the dialog
body: Moi klienci nie czytają po angielsku. Czy okno może mówić po polsku?

comments.body: Done. Set data-lang="pl" or just let it follow your page language. More languages are one command away for the site owner.

title: Roadmap: where ArghBox goes after 0.1
body: A short public list of what the team is working on, so you do not have to guess.

comments.body: Votes decide the order. Vote on what you need and we will start from the top.
